title: GAIA Value-Flow Subsystem Binding v1
description: A binding manifest that any Economic-Prophet / welfare-annealing value-flow run MUST present to be admissible as the value-flow subsystem of the GAIA world model. It does NOT redefine value; it binds the economic spine UPWARD into the world model by REFERENCE. The carrying-capacity discount and the Jacob's-ladder natural-capital / renewable base MUST be READS of the GAIA biosphere/resource state (WorldModelSubstrate W), not free parameters; the QoL objective's dimensions MUST aggregate from human-digital-twin state (population = sum of twins). Consume-not-fork: economic-prophet kernels are referenced by pinned ref, never vendored.

world_model_ref.description: Pinned reference to the world-model substrate W being read, e.g. SocioProphet/gaia-world-model@<sha>. Biosphere/resource reads resolve against this ref.

economic_spine_ref.description: Pinned soft-ref to the producing economic spine, e.g. SocioProphet/economic-prophet@<sha>. Never vendored.

welfare_annealing_ref.description: Optional pinned soft-ref to the welfare-annealing dynamics (WEA-1), now merged to economic-prophet main, e.g. SocioProphet/economic-prophet@a51a23f52dfe7b0e984a42a19a762dabe714a583 (module src/open_ep_framework/welfare_annealing/, whose gaia_binding.py emits this value_flow_binding.v1 record). Consumed by reference; never vendored; its files are never edited by this contract.

carrying_capacity.description: The welfare-annealing carrying-capacity discount. Its source MUST be a world-model read (Binding 1). A hardcoded constant is the free-parameter smell and is REJECTED (tooth T1-CONST).

read_ref.description: Resolvable world-model read, e.g. gaia://biosphere/carrying_capacity/global@<as_of>. Required when kind == world_model_read.

ecosystem_assets.description: Jacob's-ladder ecosystem / natural-capital assets. Each binds to the GAIA biosphere state (Binding 4). Renewable regeneration rate MUST be a world-model read. A non-renewable draw taking the stock below the world-model's declared reserve floor is FLAGGED (planetary-boundary breach, the paper-inductance false-growth analog; tooth T1-RESERVE).

biosphere_ref.description: World-model biosphere state reference, e.g. gaia://biosphere/forest/amazon.

kind.description: For rung == renewable_harvest the regeneration rate MUST be world_model_read (constant/none is REJECTED, tooth T4-REGEN). For depleting rungs 'none' is admissible.

floor.description: The world-model's declared reserve floor for this stock.

qol_index.description: The welfare objective's quality-of-life index. Its life-length / health / education dimensions MUST aggregate from human-digital-twin state (population = sum of twins) (Binding 3). A population QoL index not derivable from constituent human-twin dimensions is REJECTED (tooth T3-QOL).

kind.description: MUST be twin_aggregate. exogenous is the free-parameter smell and is REJECTED.

from_twin_dimension.description: Human-digital-twin state dimension this aggregates from, e.g. twin://human/dimension/health. Required when kind == twin_aggregate.
